items.title: Panzani And Cerealis In Exclusive Talks Over €1.8bn Merger
items.summary: French pasta maker Panzani Group and Portuguese food manufacturer Cerealis have entered exclusive merger talks.

items.title: Europe gives the green light to Daniel Kretinsky’s takeover bid for Fnac Darty
items.summary: The European Commission has approved Czech billionaire Daniel Kretinsky's public takeover bid for Fnac Darty. This clears the way for his plan to acquire a majority stake in the French retailer.

items.title: Fuel Retail And Service Stations Boost S Group’s 9M Growth By Over 21%
items.summary: Finland’s S Group recorded pre-tax retail sales of around €11.2 billion for the first nine months of 2026 – a 4.2% increase.

items.title: EU Fish Landings Remain Stable In 2025 – Eurostat
items.summary: The total value of EU fish landings remained at a similar level to that of 2024, reaching €5.5 billion in 2025, notes Eurostat.

items.title: Amazon invests 16.9 billion euros in German AI, cloud computing, and satellite internet
items.summary: Amazon has announced that it will invest more than 16 billion euros in its German operations by 2027. The investment is intended to further drive growth in cloud computing, artificial intelligence (AI), satellite internet, and media production.

items.title: PepsiCo shutters Tennessee bottling plant amid soda slump
items.summary: The closure comes after the beverage giant's CEO laid out a cost-cutting plan to improve flattening growth.

items.title: 4 strategies Coca-Cola, PepsiCo, Spindrift and others are using to revitalize RTD tea
items.summary: With US RTD tea sales falling, Coca-Cola, PepsiCo and other brands are betting on zero sugar, bold flavors, functional benefits and premium ingredients to revive growth.

items.title: Belgian fashion brand Zuri is not allowed to use that name, according to Zara
items.summary: The Spanish fashion giant Inditex has won a trademark dispute with the Belgian fashion and cosmetics brand Zuri. According to the European Union Intellectual Property Office (EUIPO), Zuri’s logo bears too many similarities to that of Zara, and the Belgian brand risks benefiting…

items.title: Marie-Stella-Maris opens fourth Belgian store in Brussels
items.summary: The Dutch skincare brand Marie-Stella-Maris will open a flagship store on Avenue Louise in Brussels on November 6. This expansion follows strong growth in Belgium, where online sales and the number of online customers nearly doubled this year.

items.title: Adidas reports record revenue and profit
items.summary: In the third quarter, Adidas posted both its highest-ever revenue and its highest-ever operating profit. The sporting goods manufacturer is raising its profit forecast for 2026 by 200 million euros, partly thanks to a substantial refund of U.S. import duties.

items.title: Ghirardelli parent ousts CEO as growth slows
items.summary: Lindt & Sprüngli said Adalbert Lechner will leave the company, with former chief Dieter Weisskopf taking over on an interim basis.

items.title: M&M’s at 85: How Mars built a billion-dollar confectionery icon
items.summary: Mars is celebrating 85 years of M&M’s. Discover how the iconic confectionery brand has evolved through innovation, flavour launches and global expansion.

items.title: Nestlé to close Ohio factory by end of 2027
items.summary: The food giant will move production to South Carolina, saying it is "the most sustainable path forward" as consumer needs and volumes shift.

items.title: Kroger To Focus On Grocery Business Under New CEO As Competition Heats Up
items.summary: Kroger said it would focus on its core grocery business under CEO Greg Foran's first plan shared with investors on Tuesday.

items.title: Unilever To Sell Welly Bandage Brand To Forward Consumer Partners
items.summary: Unilever has agreed to sell Welly Health PBC to private-equity firm Forward Consumer Partners, but did not disclose financial terms.

items.title: Danone’s AI commerce goal: ‘Trusted by machines and desired by humans’
items.summary: Danone wants its brands to be trusted by AI shopping agents and desired by consumers. Arthur Sylvestre explains the digital strategy behind that goal.

items.title: French Retailers Count The Cost Of Weekend Riots
items.summary: Violence on the sidelines of mass protests in France against rising cost of living left around 1,500 stores impacted, initial estimates showed.

items.title: Mattel reorganizes European sales organization around retail channels
items.summary: Toy manufacturer Mattel is restructuring its commercial organization in Europe. Going forward, the company will manage its sales teams by retail channel rather than primarily by country. The toy retailer Smyths will even have its own management team.

items.title: French retail group Casino is changing its name
items.summary: Casino, the French group behind seven neighborhood store chains, is now called PLESIO (Greek for “proximity”). The company aims to position itself more strongly as a specialist in proximity and to clearly distinguish the group from the Casino chain.

items.title: Gifi seeks protection from creditors: French discounter fights for survival
items.summary: The French discount chain Gifi is seeking court protection after years of strategic blunders, a failed IT operation, and plummeting sales figures. The future of more than 500 stores and 6,000 employees is at stake.

items.title: French Retailer Groupe Casino Rebrands As Plesio
items.summary: Groupe Casino has announced that it is rebranding under a new name 'Plesio' - a Greek word meaning 'proximity'.

items.title: Carrefour lowers forecasts following violent protests in France
items.summary: The recent riots in France are weighing on consumer confidence and threaten to drive up costs, Carrefour says. Despite a rise in sales in the third quarter, the retailer has issued a profit warning.

items.title: Carrefour Belgium reports revenue growth and market share gains
items.summary: Carrefour Belgium closed out the third quarter with like-for-like sales growth of 2.3%. This was accompanied by a 0.2 percentage point increase in market share and a further rise in customer satisfaction, the retailer reported.

items.title: Carrefour Warns Of Up To €200m Hit From Riots And Looting
items.summary: Carrefour cut its annual earnings forecast as riots, looting and curfews in France raised costs and disrupted store trading.

items.title: Gremlins In the Machine – DIA Partners With Warner Bros. On Gamified Range
items.summary: Spain’s DIA is rolling out a range of products inspired by the Gremlins films, as part of a gamification and nostalgia campaign.

items.title: Jumbo and Picnic benefited the most from the Albert Heijn cyberattack
items.summary: As a result of the recent cyberattack, Albert Heijn lost a significant amount of market share in the Netherlands last week. Jumbo and the online supermarket Picnic, in particular, were able to capitalize on the market leader’s difficulties.

items.title: Rising losses at handbag brand Delvaux
items.summary: Luxury handbag maker Delvaux just can't seem to get out of the red. Of the past seven fiscal years, the company has posted a loss in six of them. Still, owner Richemont continues to believe in the brand.

items.title: Fortenova Group Completes Sale Of Serbian Retail Business To Alta Retail
items.summary: Fortenova has exited the Serbian retail market, following the completion of the sale of Idea Marketi and four affiliated companies.

items.title: UPF classification doesn’t tell the whole story about nutrition, study reveals
items.summary: An IFIC and NIQ analysis of 40,000 US grocery products finds nutrient density varies among ultra-processed foods, while non-UPFs cost more on average.

items.title: 10 big ingredients concentrated in a single region
items.summary: To protect against disasters, diversification of supply is often crucial. But many of the world's biggest ingredients have much of their production concentrated in a single country or region.

items.title: Tesco Expands Clubcard Partners, Morrisons Upgrades Loyalty App
items.summary: Tesco and Morrisons have upgraded their customer loyalty schemes, expanding point collection and adding new features such as a shopping list.

items.title: Less heat, more appeal: Samyang bets on swicy noodles and protein pasta
items.summary: Samyang is diversifying beyond the Buldak brand’s extreme spice to capture new consumer trends and expand its global growth opportunities

items.title: Amy’s Kitchen tackles ultra-processed food myths in national campaign
items.summary: The campaign is intended to position minimally processed foods as the better bargain in the long run.

items.title: Mondelēz launches gluten-free Ritz crackers
items.summary: The snack giant has previously released gluten-free versions of Oreo and Chips Ahoy! as brands look for growth by catering to a range of dietary needs.

items.title: Just Eat And Morrisons Expand Robot Grocery Delivery
items.summary: Just Eat and Morrisons have announced plans to expand autonomous robot grocery delivery to Cambourne in Cambridgeshire.

items.title: Mars’ analysis reveals where retail emissions add up
items.summary: As retail becomes more technology-driven, Mars sees ecommerce and consolidated delivery networks as materially less carbon-intensive than traditional store-based shopping.

items.title: Forget breakfast: The battle for the morning snack is on
items.summary: Morning snacking is emerging as a distinct eating occasion, creating new opportunities for breakfast, confectionery and functional food brands. Discover the trends, ingredients and formats shaping the growing mid-morning market.

items.title: Dairy’s fight for growth and shelf space
items.summary: Explore dairy innovation trends, from high-protein products and plant-based competition to creamers, milk market insights and AI-powered commerce.

items.title: Creamers move beyond coffee with flavors, cold foams and café-inspired experiences
items.summary: SPINS data shows consumers gravitating toward flavored creamers and cold foams that deliver café-inspired flavors and textures, while dairy-focused brands balance indulgence with simpler ingredient lists.

items.title: Can plant proteins help ease the whey squeeze?
items.summary: Whey prices remain more than double year-ago levels. Explore how ADM and other ingredient suppliers are using plant proteins and hybrid formulations to meet demand.

items.title: New data platform reveals opportunities for dairy milk to win back shelf space
items.summary: MilkPEP’s new Milkscape platform uses AI and market data to help dairy processors and retailers spot consumer trends, drive milk innovation and grow sales.

items.title: As consumers rethink fat, whole milk gets a second look
items.summary: A growing focus on protein, satiety and whole-food nutrition is fueling renewed consumer interest in full-fat dairy, particularly whole milk.

items.title: Better Dairy self-affirms GRAS status for lactopontin
items.summary: Better Dairy has self-affirmed GRAS status for precision-fermented lactopontin, paving the way for US nutrition and supplement product launches.

items.title: The Barn opents tenth organic fresh market and plans to open two more in 2027
items.summary: After nearly ten years in business, the organic grocery chain The Barn has reached the ten-store milestone: on November 7, its tenth store will open in Woluwe-Saint-Lambert. Two more stores will open in Brussels next year.
